rationale_evidence.anchor: M-Q3 and M-Q4 are ONE decision seen twice
rationale_evidence.statement: Sharpens gap M-Q3 (missing metric): the gap is not merely 'we lack a number' but that the dimensions are heterogeneous and their improvement directions differ, so no scalar metric can exist without a normative weighting -- and a weighting is a normative act, which is exactly gap M-Q4 (the undeclared loss function). Concludes M-Q3 and M-Q4 are the same decision seen twice, merged as M-Q3prime, a fact neither artifact 17 nor Step 291 had noticed.

rationale_evidence.anchor: \equiv_D \textbf{ silently presupposes a } dimension \textbf{ object.} The ratified eight carry Proposition, but neither dimension nor value.
rationale_evidence.statement: S2228's three-way sentence/proposition/dimension/value separation exposes a presupposition inside the ratified result equiv_D (264.15, value-level semantic equality: 3m not-equiv_str 300cm but 3m equiv_D 300cm) -- this comparison is only possible if a dimension (here, length) is fixed; without d, equiv_D has nothing to quantify over. The ratified eight primitives carry Proposition but neither dimension nor value, though equiv_D operates on the latter. Registered as D-Q1 with two open readings: (a) dimension/value are derived structure inside Proposition, so equiv_D is well-founded and the gap is merely documentary (assessed as the cheaper reading, not derived here); (b) they are missing primitives, which would contradict C-022's '50 attack classes, no counterexample' completeness claim. Also notes tension with Step 291's Audit A, which rates equiv_D Level-5 decidable 'but at the wrong level' -- this finding says the wrong level has no carrier at all, not merely irrelevance.

rationale_evidence.anchor: SIX disjoint operation vocabularies in the estate
rationale_evidence.statement: Counts six disjoint operation vocabularies now in the estate: (1) 272A's O_sem, 19 operations; (2) external_research pseudo-algorithm, 43 functions; (3) the corpus registry (256.2/259.7/261.19), 22 operations; (4) Ch13's type ontology, 7 (primitives not operations); (5) Omega_K={Discriminate,Qualify,Transition} + 11 named (artifact 20); (6, new, this batch) {E,R,C,X,Q,Z} from S2226 -- registered as G-91 (was three vocabularies at G-68, four at G-86, now six). Notes Qualify appears in both the fifth and sixth vocabularies (G-92): two independently constructed minimal-ish algebras both contain the one irreducible gap, reinforcing artifact 20's finding that any minimal kernel algebra containing Qualify inherits G1. Also notes both new sources ask about closure/associativity/non-commutativity, matching the corpus's own prior non-law (25J.46: 'we should not yet impose universal commutativity').

rationale_evidence.anchor: All 22 registry operations change VALUES or MEMBERSHIP. NONE restructures the interpretive frame.
rationale_evidence.statement: Connects Reframe to artifact 21's K_t=(D_t,V_t,...) distinction between dimension discovery (D_t->D_{t+1}) and value improvement (v_t(d)->v_{t+1}(d)): Reframe is D_t->D_t' with V_t reinterpreted -- the same distinction seen from a different chapter. Observes all 22 registry operations change values or membership; none restructures the interpretive frame. Two independent sources (the purification file and Ch2) now say state change includes restructuring, and the registry has no operation of that kind -- registered as O-Q3, a gap in O's coverage distinct from its membership rule (N-4). Also notes Ch2's Knowledge!=Decision!=Action!=Result corroborates Ch18's five-way separation (artifact 25) and Step 256.21's Command!=Transformation, and that Ch2 opens by restating the ratified N notin K_t -- continuity with the ratified base, not a parallel ontology.

## Rationale
- [S2230] (ANALYSIS/CORRECTION) Sharpens gap M-Q3 (missing metric): the gap is not merely 'we lack a number' but that the dimensions are heterogeneous and their improvement directions differ, so no scalar metric can exist without a normative weighting -- and a weighting is a normative act, which is exactly gap M-Q4 (the undeclared loss function). Concludes M-Q3 and M-Q4 are the same decision seen twice, merged as M-Q3prime, a fact neither artifact 17 nor Step 291 had noticed.
- [S2230] (ARGUMENT/OPEN-QUESTION) S2228's three-way sentence/proposition/dimension/value separation exposes a presupposition inside the ratified result equiv_D (264.15, value-level semantic equality: 3m not-equiv_str 300cm but 3m equiv_D 300cm) -- this comparison is only possible if a dimension (here, length) is fixed; without d, equiv_D has nothing to quantify over. The ratified eight primitives carry Proposition but neither dimension nor value, though equiv_D operates on the latter. Registered as D-Q1 with two open readings: (a) dimension/value are derived structure inside Proposition, so equiv_D is well-founded and the gap is merely documentary (assessed as the cheaper reading, not derived here); (b) they are missing primitives, which would contradict C-022's '50 attack classes, no counterexample' completeness claim. Also notes tension with Step 291's Audit A, which rates equiv_D Level-5 decidable 'but at the wrong level' -- this finding says the wrong level has no carrier at all, not merely irrelevance.
- [S2230] (ANALYSIS/GOVERNANCE) Counts six disjoint operation vocabularies now in the estate: (1) 272A's O_sem, 19 operations; (2) external_research pseudo-algorithm, 43 functions; (3) the corpus registry (256.2/259.7/261.19), 22 operations; (4) Ch13's type ontology, 7 (primitives not operations); (5) Omega_K={Discriminate,Qualify,Transition} + 11 named (artifact 20); (6, new, this batch) {E,R,C,X,Q,Z} from S2226 -- registered as G-91 (was three vocabularies at G-68, four at G-86, now six). Notes Qualify appears in both the fifth and sixth vocabularies (G-92): two independently constructed minimal-ish algebras both contain the one irreducible gap, reinforcing artifact 20's finding that any minimal kernel algebra containing Qualify inherits G1. Also notes both new sources ask about closure/associativity/non-commutativity, matching the corpus's own prior non-law (25J.46: 'we should not yet impose universal commutativity').
- [S2259] (ANALYSIS/EXTENSION) Connects Reframe to artifact 21's K_t=(D_t,V_t,...) distinction between dimension discovery (D_t->D_{t+1}) and value improvement (v_t(d)->v_{t+1}(d)): Reframe is D_t->D_t' with V_t reinterpreted -- the same distinction seen from a different chapter. Observes all 22 registry operations change values or membership; none restructures the interpretive frame. Two independent sources (the purification file and Ch2) now say state change includes restructuring, and the registry has no operation of that kind -- registered as O-Q3, a gap in O's coverage distinct from its membership rule (N-4). Also notes Ch2's Knowledge!=Decision!=Action!=Result corroborates Ch18's five-way separation (artifact 25) and Step 256.21's Command!=Transformation, and that Ch2 opens by restating the ratified N notin K_t -- continuity with the ratified base, not a parallel ontology.
